## Description

Reviewer queue of doctors with register, number, expiry and uploaded certificate. Recording, signing notes and e-prescriptions stay locked for the doctor until a reviewer checks the official register. Approve records reviewer, register checked and time; reject or ask for changes sends the owner a plain reason and leaves the rest of the practice working.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a doctor is unverified, when they try to sign a note, then the API refuses.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a reviewer approves, when it is saved, then name, register and time are recorded.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a licence is rejected, when the owner is told, then the reason is in plain words and other staff keep working.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
